topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: This city, it's got layers. You dig deep, and you find things you can't explain. Yesterday, some schmoe came to me, says he’s got a time capsule he doesn’t remember burying. Beating around the bush, he claims, but I've heard stranger. Thing is, the capsule bore marks of time, sure, but it smelled... off. Like it'd been dug up and reburied. I took a look inside – old photos, a couple of coins, a diary with pages that didn’t quite match the era. Someone was playing a game, and this guy was just the next player. I ain’t got all the pieces yet, but I smelled a story brewing, and it was the kind that could unravel more secrets than it held.
